name: Mainhausen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Mainhausen (quartered with horse, Mainz wheel, radio mast and fir cone).
history: The flag was approved for the municipality by the Hessian Minister of the Interior on 28 December 1982.

features.role: Mainhausen arms — quartered with horse, wheel, mast and cone
